content:
Facebook: links in the post text are clickable — put mccraylearninglab.com right in the caption. Keep hashtags light (3-5).
Instagram feed: links in captions are NOT clickable — write "link in bio" and put the URL in your bio (or a Linktree). Hashtags can go up to ~30.
Stories (FB & IG): add a link sticker so it's tappable.
Everywhere: mccraylearninglab.com (or a specific story path).
title: Platform quick-rules
